race.comment: EZEIZA (6) resumes as the horse to beat, with a Dalby trial last month, a 2kg claim and a stable that has strong local credentials all helping her return profile. Her latest campaign ended with mixed BM55 form, but she was respected in betting at Kilcoy and has placed at this distance before, which keeps the fresh case solid. I AM PIETRA (10) brings the most reliable recent line after finishing second to Anthropology at Eidsvold and has the right 1200m record to be dangerous again. HAWAIIAN BLOOM (3) was third in a FM Class 1 at Toowoomba after striking interference and being held up, so she has a genuine excuse and now gets a 3kg claim. OUR WARRIOR (5) adds depth after missing by a long neck at Stanthorpe at odds and is proven around this trip, though he has to reproduce that bounce after a very plain run two back. ENTITLE (1) lifted strongly when winning by a long neck two runs back at Emerald. Definitely among the contenders.
